_comment: Converted from .kiro/hooks/. Claude Code hook events: PreToolUse, PostToolUse, userPromptSubmitted, Stop, SubagentStop, Notification, PreCompact, SessionStart. fileEdited/fileCreated/fileDeleted not supported.

hooks.command: echo 'If wrote .drawio: validate no self-closing edges (edge=1 must have <mxGeometry> child), no <mxfile> wrapper, starts with <mxGraphModel>. Then run drawio_export_png.'
echo 'If wrote .drawio: call drawio_auto_layout(file_path), fix issues until 0, then export PNG.'
echo 'If source file modified (.kt,.ts,.py,.go,.rs,.cs): run incremental indexer — npx tsx .analysis/code-intelligence/scripts/src/incremental-indexer.ts --files <file>'
echo 'REMINDER: Before writing .drawio, run mem_search(drawio layout pattern proven, detail=true) for proven patterns.'
echo 'REMINDER: KB-search-before-action rule — run mem_search for existing solutions before writing code/docs.'
echo 'REMINDER: If editing build.gradle.kts/package.json/pyproject.toml version, ensure version bump + tests pass before tag.'
echo 'Log response summary via mem_ingest: type=CONTEXT, source=chat-response, tags=chat,stream,agent'
echo 'REMINDER: After task, if new method discovered, mem_ingest as LESSON_LEARNED. If doc created, mem_ingest_file with full content.'
echo 'REMINDER: After each SDLC phase, SM must attach {DOC}-v{version}-{TICKET}.docx + all .drawio files to Jira.'
echo 'Log prompt summary via mem_ingest: type=CONTEXT, source=chat-prompt, tags=chat,stream,user'
echo 'REMINDER: If running SM pipeline, append row to documents/{TICKET}/RUN-LOG.md after each agent invocation.'
echo 'REMINDER: SM should read STATUS.json.circuitBreaker before each phase — state=open = HARD STOP, do NOT retry.'
echo 'REMINDER: SM should check tokenBudget before invoke — 80percent=report-only, 100percent=hard stop.'
